label: Vietnam police charge ONUS/VNDC founder and eight others with fraud, laundering
note: 2026-03-23: The Ministry of Public Security's Investigation Security Agency opened a criminal case against Vuong Le Vinh Nhan (Eric Vuong) and eight accomplices for using computer networks to appropriate property and for money laundering; the Supreme People's Procuracy approved the custody orders, reported 2026-03-26. At its 2026-04-03 briefing the ministry said the group created VNDC and the VNDC Wallet exchange (renamed ONUS in October 2021) in 2018, advertised VNDC as backed 1:1 by deposits at large Vietnamese commercial banks, and that the VNDC issued was not actually deposited in banks. Corroborated by VTV (2026-03-26).
